name: Kourou ELS (Soyuz launch complex)
tagline: Europe's Soyuz pad: first Soyuz outside Baikonur or Plesetsk (2011), 27 launches, eight for Galileo
description: ELS was the Soyuz pad at Europe's Spaceport, about 13 km north-west of the Ariane pads near Sinnamary. Soyuz-ST flew from it 27 times between 21 October 2011 and 10 February 2022, the first Soyuz launches outside Baikonur and Plesetsk. At 5.3 degrees north the rocket could lift up to 3 tonnes to geostationary transfer orbit, against 1.7 tonnes from Baikonur. Payloads included eight Galileo launches, Pleiades 1A and 1B, Gaia (2013), Sentinel-1A and 1B, MetOp-C and CHEOPS. Twenty-six of the 27 flights succeeded; on 22 August 2014 a Fregat upper-stage fault left two Galileo satellites in the wrong orbit. Russia suspended operations in February 2022, and Wikipedia reports that the pad was demolished on 24 April 2026 to make room for MaiaSpace's Maia rocket.
best_known_for: Europe's Soyuz pad: first Soyuz outside Baikonur or Plesetsk (2011), 27 launches, eight for Galileo
